Product Naming & Trademark Usage

The distinction between and is intentional. Use as the primary name for the framework and its technical ecosystem. Reserve for the licensed commercial product and the capabilities provided specifically through that product.

  • — the free, MIT-licensed state management framework and the primary name for the technology. Use when discussing the API, FeatureCell, State, the Pipeline, Behavior and Controller capabilities, framework integrations, documentation, or the project generally.
  • — the licensed commercial product built on . Use only when discussing its licensed runtime, commercial services, or product-specific features. Development use is available under the Community License; production use requires a valid license. Do not use as an interchangeable name for the free framework.
  • — the official name for a feature-scoped State declaration. Write it as one word with a capital F and C.
  • — the official catchphrase. Preserve the wording and capitalization exactly as shown.
  • /* — the official package scope. Use the lowercase scoped format when referring to a published package.

Use the trademark symbol on the first mention of a trademarked name in an article. Subsequent mentions do not require the symbol.

Usage Guidelines
↑ top

Permitted

  • Use the wordmark or brand variant when referencing or by name in articles, blog posts, or presentations.
  • Use the symbol or logo variant as an icon in toolbars, dashboards, or integration listings.
  • Maintain the original aspect ratio and do not alter colors or proportions.

Not Permitted

  • Do not use logos in a way that implies endorsement or affiliation without permission.
  • Do not modify, distort, or recolor the logos.
  • Do not use logos as part of your own product name or branding.

For full trademark policy details, see the Trademark Usage Policy.
